subject: Startups
title: The Rule of 40
description: A 60-second lesson on The Rule of 40.

hook.text: SaaS investors use a simple test: revenue growth rate plus profit margin should exceed 40%. It's called the Rule of 40.

buildup.text: A company growing 60% with -20% margins scores 40. A company growing 20% with 20% margins also scores 40. Both pass.

discovery.text: The rule captures the tradeoff between growth and profitability. High growth excuses losses. Low growth demands profits.

twist.text: Companies below 40 struggle: not growing fast enough to justify losses, not profitable enough for slow growth.

climax.text: Snowflake, Datadog, and CrowdStrike all exceed 40. They're the SaaS elite. Most public SaaS companies fall below.

punchline.text: Grow fast, profit well, or do both. Just hit 40.

quiz.question: What does the Rule of 40 measure?
options: Revenue growth rate plus profit margin
